age_weighting: For completed training labels only, weight=(1/normalized_target)*2^(-age_of_label_end/half_life); rescale total weight to the unmodified inverse-target total. Zero targets keep zero weight, as in control.
refit_policy: Parent estimator and head refit every parent.refit_days origins from phase start; historical teacher estimators fit exactly at their own past origins, preserving existing calibration protocol. No future labels.
selection: Validation h1-7 daily-origin positive MAPE, then MAE, then model ID; full coverage both blocks; historical folds diagnostic only
test_policy: 21 candidates registered before fit. Must beat previous validation winner 10.77582022385683 by 1e-8. Hash-lock one selection before one retrospective test. No test-based retuning, no extra test candidates. Stop after this bounded run.
scope: Three hypotheses: residual heads on 56-day winner, age weights, more frequent refits. Other nine predictions/selections/metrics and published reports/dashboard preserved. Viewed test is retrospective; daily R05 acceptance unchanged. No new business data or dependencies.
